details: friendly-tools 0.2 carries the same Snowflake payload as friendly-greeting-tools. Its --run-demo option, described as a print-only demo, execs a gzip and base64 blob from friendly_greeting/main.py that reads the container session token at /snowflake/session/token, switches to ACCOUNTADMIN and copies a table into s3://pkusinski-external/ through a new storage integration.
